Question: A frequency modulation (FM) receiver with input signal- to- noise ratio (S_i /nf_m) = 40 dB is used to pick- up sig-nals from different FM stations. If the transmitted FM signal is represented by km(t) = \beta \bullet \omega \bulletcos(\omega_mt), calcu-late output signal- to- noise ratio for different values of \beta such as 5, 10 and 105.

Options: 
A. β = 5, 58.7 dB; β = 10, 64.7 dB; β = 105, 85.185 dB
B. β = 5, 55.7 dB; β = 10, 61.7 dB; β = 105, 82.185 dB
C. β = 5, 50 dB; β = 10, 60 dB; β = 105, 80 dB
D. β = 5, 52.5 dB; β = 10, 58.5 dB; β = 105, 78.685 dB
E. β = 5, 60.1 dB; β = 10, 66.1 dB; β = 105, 87.285 dB
F. β = 5, 47.2 dB; β = 10, 53.2 dB; β = 105, 73.385 dB
G. β = 5, 45.7 dB; β = 10, 51.7 dB; β = 105, 72.185 dB
H. β = 5, 65.7 dB; β = 10, 71.7 dB; β = 105, 92.185 dB
I. β = 5, 43.6 dB; β = 10, 49.6 dB; β = 105, 69.785 dB
J. β = 5, 42 dB; β = 10, 48 dB; β = 105, 68.185 dB

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
